g.text: All six turn limits | Same callback and timestamp counts within each control pair
Ratios below 1 are observed whole-program outcomes, not negative yield costs. Runtime effects confound subtraction.
Primary: 7 runs; other groups: 3. Error bars show the range of paired ratios.
LCG updates are source-level work, not a guarantee of 64 instructions after optimization.
